title: 托管状态机：五个状态与谁能推动转移
mermaid:
stateDiagram-v2
    state "Created 已创建" as Created
    state "Funded 已存款" as Funded
    state "Disputed 争议中" as Disputed
    state "Released 已付卖方" as Released
    state "Refunded 已退买方" as Refunded
    [*] --> Created: constructor 买方部署
    Created --> Funded: deposit 买方存 ETH
    Funded --> Released: confirmDelivery 买方确认
    Funded --> Refunded: refundBySeller 卖方退款
    Funded --> Disputed: raiseDispute 买方或卖方
    Disputed --> Released: resolve true 仲裁人
    Disputed --> Refunded: resolve false 仲裁人
    Released --> [*]
    Refunded --> [*]
notes: ETH 由买方 deposit 存入合约，最终只会流向 seller（_release）或 buyer（_refund）之一。
每个函数都带 inState 检查，状态不对就抛 WrongState，调用者不对就抛 NotAuthorized，整笔回滚。
仲裁人只能在 Disputed 状态下 resolve，Funded 状态下他无权动钱。
Released 和 Refunded 是终态，没有任何函数能从这两个状态再转出去。

title: 一次正常交易：存款到确认收货
mermaid:
sequenceDiagram participant B as 买方 buyer participant E as Escrow 合约 participant S as 卖方 seller B->>E: deposit 附带 msg.value Note over E: 检查 msg.sender == buyer 且 msg.value > 0
amount = msg.value，state = Funded B->>E: confirmDelivery Note over E: _release 先改账
amount = 0，state = Released E->>S: seller.call 转出 value alt 转账失败 E-->>B: revert TransferFailed，全部回滚 end
notes: 钱的路径是 买方 → Escrow 合约 → 卖方，合约只在中间暂存 amount。
若先转账再改状态，卖方合约可在收款回调里重入重复领取，所以 _release 先把 amount 清零。
Checks-Effects-Interactions：先检查，再改 amount 和 state，最后才 call 转账。
